name: Loo
summary: A 3-card trick-taking gambling game where players win shares of a pool per trick and pay penalties if looed for taking none.
rules_text: Played with 52 cards ranking A K Q J 10 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2. Each deal dealer puts 3 chips in pool. Simple pool: deal 3 cards each, no dropout. Player left of dealer leads, must follow suit and must beat the highest card so far if able. If a player cannot follow, any card may be played and top of stock is turned for trumps; thereafter winner must lead trump if held, including Ace or King if top trump, and void players must trump to beat if able. Double pool: deal 3 cards each plus a 3-card miss next to dealer and turn next card for trumps. In turn each player may pass and sit out, stand with own hand, or throw own hand away to take the unseen miss and must then play. If all but dealer pass dealer wins pool. If one stands and rest pass dealer must stand, take miss, or defend miss with no win/loss. Tricks are won by highest trump or if none by highest of led suit. Pool is split one third per trick to winners; each active player who took no tricks pays 3 chips to next pool.
